field_definitions.realized_pnl: Sum of available net_profit on MT5 closing deal records in the UTC period.
field_definitions.unrealized_pnl: MT5 account profit at collection time.
field_definitions.drawdown_abs: Running peak equity minus observed equity.
field_definitions.drawdown_pct: Drawdown_abs divided by running peak equity, when the peak is positive.
field_definitions.win_rate: Profitable closing deal records divided by profitable plus losing records; breakeven records are excluded.
field_definitions.profit_factor: Gross profitable net results divided by the absolute gross losing net results.
